query: SELECT c_charge_degree, MEDIAN(med_decile_score) AS med_decile_score FROM (SELECT race, c_charge_degree, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY decile_score) AS med_decile_score FROM Compas GROUP BY race, c_charge_degree) t GROUP BY c_charge_degree;

SELECT race, MEDIAN(med_decile_score) AS med_decile_score FROM (SELECT c_charge_degree, race, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY decile_score) AS med_decile_score FROM Compas GROUP BY c_charge_degree, race) t GROUP BY race;
SELECT age_cat, AVG(avg_decile_score) AS avg_decile_score FROM (SELECT race, age_cat, AVG(decile_score) AS avg_decile_score FROM Compas GROUP BY race, age_cat) t GROUP BY age_cat;
SELECT race, AVG(avg_decile_score) AS avg_decile_score FROM (SELECT age_cat, race, AVG(decile_score) AS avg_decile_score FROM Compas GROUP BY age_cat, race) t GROUP BY race;
